- [RARC.13.7] **Engine subsystems are first-class.** Working memory, the
  network, the agenda and its conflict resolver, the clock source, the
  dispatcher and the consumption loop are each named, and each reaches the
  integrator only through the stream and the typed callbacks ([RARC.5.1]).
gap_reason: Names the engine's subsystems and their single integrator surface. An architectural statement; the surface is tied where it is stated (RARC.5, NCBK).
